passage: Meaning & History. Latinized form of the Greek name Κορίννα (Korinna), which was derived from κόρη ( kore) meaning "maiden". This was the name of a Greek lyric poet of the 5th century BC. The Roman poet Ovid used it for the main female character in his book Amores [1].
